action.command:
cd /workspace && echo '--- hocuspocus logs ---' && docker logs workspace-hocuspocus-1 2>&1 | tail -20; echo '--- WS connect test (python) ---'; python3 - <<'EOF'
import socket, base64, os
key = base64.b64encode(os.urandom(16)).decode()
req = (f"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost:1234\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\n"
       f"Connection: Upgrade\r\nSec-WebSocket-Key: {key}\r\nSec-WebSocket-Version: 13\r\n\r\n")
s = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 1234), timeout=10)
s.sendall(req.encode())
data = b""
try:
    while b"\r\n\r\n" not in data:
        chunk = s.recv(4096)
        if not chunk: break
        data += chunk
except socket.timeout:
    pass
print(data.decode(errors="replace").split("\r\n\r\n")[0])
s.close()
EOF
